purpose: Strict Stage 1 Cosmic Companion SQL allowlist. Never run supabase db push from the repository migrations folder.
doNotApply: any file already in production schema_migrations
stagingHistoryNote: Staging applied the same Stage 1 Nova files under different version timestamps, plus a duplicate nova_artwork_bucket_limits_repo row. Do not copy staging schema_migrations into production. Do not db push this allowlist onto staging; apply only the pending serial pair after approval.

safeDeploySequence.whyFrontendFirst: The dual-format frontend accepts both ^[0-9]{12}$ and R-XXXXXXXX. Deploying Pages before SQL means Ace (000001000000) keeps rendering. Applying SQL after that only swaps Ace's serial; new inserts mint collectible IDs. Never deploy a collectible-only frontend before SQL if any legacy serial remains.
steps: 1. Preflight read-only: confirm Ace public_id f2c18bdb-9de8-44fd-89b7-61b56bb52964, username Ace, rarity Rare, serial ~ ^[0-9]{12}$, sharing/artwork/owner unchanged.
2. Merge PR #107 and wait for Cloudflare Pages production success (dual-format frontend live).
3. Smoke Ace public card + /nova owner view: legacy serial still renders; no NovaCard crash.
4. Apply ONLY 20261025120000_nova_collectible_serial.sql on production aojrbxoqbgyxmfljqpqj (dual CHECK; INSERT generator; gated identity trigger).
5. Apply ONLY 20261025120100_nova_ace_pilot_serial_reissue.sql (one-time Ace reissue + collectible-only CHECK).
6. Verify Ace: serial ~ ^R-[23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ]{8}$, public_id unchanged, audit ace_pilot_serial_reissue, artwork URL /card/c/{publicId}/art still works.

rollbackRecovery.frontendOnly: Revert Pages to previous main deploy if dual-format frontend regresses. No SQL needed.
rollbackRecovery.afterFormatMigrationBeforeReissue: 20261025120000 is additive (dual CHECK + generator). Leaving it applied is safe; Ace still has numeric serial. Do not reverse unless instructed — reversing requires restoring nova_keep_identity and sequential default carefully.
rollbackRecovery.afterAceReissue: Serial change is permanent by design. Do not rewrite Ace back to 000001000000 via casual UPDATE (identity trigger blocks it). Recovery = leave new collectible serial; public_id/URL/artwork remain. If reissue migration failed mid-way, check audit + serial; re-run is idempotent when already collectible.
never: supabase db push of the whole migrations folder
changing owner_id, public_id, answers, artwork paths, or sharing to 'fix' a serial
applying partner/announcement migrations from this allowlist
